title: Field memory becomes the operator
summary: The existing field-computing pass ends at -mp-ri -> InformationFlow, where coherent carrier interactions write a slower routing field but the main implementation still uses an explicit coupling construction. SelectCarryBindWriteAskSelect continues that line by making the stored slow Navier-Stokes collision field itself alter the trajectory of a later cue under bounded local readout. The important inheritance is not a claim that fluid dynamics discovers semantics; it is the removal of the transducer between stored medium and later computation.

nodes.claim: Assembles SELECT -> CARRY -> BIND -> WRITE -> ASK in a nonlinear fluid where a collision-specific slow vorticity field persists and directly changes the physical trajectory of a later carrier.
nodes.survived: Matched phase/frequency/spatial carrier interactions leave a selective slow field after washout; direct recall uses that raw stored field with no learned-field amplification or DeltaOmega-to-modal transducer; the later cue produces a bounded local response whose magnitude and sign depend strongly on the stored relation.
nodes.killed: The construction does not show that bare Navier-Stokes discovers carrier semantics, learning goals or an addressing code, and it does not establish a computational advantage over conventional learned or signal-processing systems.

edges.why: SelectCarryBindWriteAskSelect explicitly names InformationFlow as one of the lines it assembles and retains its spatial/frequency/phase carrier addressing while moving recall into the stored fluid itself.

The repo explicitly names -mp-ri as an input line and returns to its original ambition that the nonlinear medium itself should participate in later routing, while preserving the later carrier-addressing correction.

motifs.title: The stored medium can be the later operator
motifs.description: -mp-ri established persistent nonlinear fluid structure but needed an added plasticity rule. InformationFlow supplied explicit coherent addressing. SelectCarryBindWriteAskSelect removes the remaining projection in the default path: the slow stored collision field itself changes the later cue trajectory seen by a bounded receiver. The surviving claim is a proof-of-mechanism about persistent distributed media, not a claim of autonomous fluid learning.
